text:
maya: quick alert - embeddings eu-west1 memory climb since 22:40 UTC, error rate ~3.5%. suspect kvcache churn. proposing hotfix + narrow shift to eu-west2 in 23:00-23:30 window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request DR-2026-512 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.1-hotfix-a. plan: canary 4% -> 20% -> full.
duncan: prefer keeping v3.2.0 pinned for instant rollback. need infra lead expedited ok.
rana: rana: approved via DM. cadence: 4% for 5m, 20% for 8m; proceed to full only if metrics stable. post-release-note after cutoff.
maya: rollback triggers: immediate rollback to v3.2.0 if errors >1% OR p95 +200ms for 3m OR any OOM.
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-8200 created for p95>200ms or errors>1%. escalation: oncall -> infra-lead.
duncan: ops runbook snippet:
```
# start canary
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-hotfix-a --percent 4 --note "hotfix-DR-2026-512"
# rollback
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.0
```
releasebot: Release note attached: "Embeddings v3.2.1-hotfix-a — kvcache stabilization" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-512
maya: ops-bot schedule at 23:00 UTC. operators: maya, duncan. will update thread after hold. :hourglass:
